states.name: S0
states.meaning: No nonempty suffix since reset matches a prefix of 1101; start_shifting=0. When reset=0, next state is S1 if data=1, else S0. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

states.name: S1
states.meaning: Longest matched suffix is 1; start_shifting=0. When reset=0, next state is S11 if data=1, else S0. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

states.name: S11
states.meaning: Longest matched suffix is 11; start_shifting=0. When reset=0, next state is S11 if data=1 (overlapping 1s), else S110. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

states.name: S110
states.meaning: Longest matched suffix is 110; start_shifting=0. When reset=0, next state is FOUND if data=1, else S0. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

states.name: FOUND
states.meaning: Sequence 1101 has been detected; start_shifting=1 sticky. When reset=0, remains FOUND for either data value. When reset=1, state becomes S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset and data are sampled; visible after the edge settles

rules.condition: reset==1 at the sampled posedge; synchronous reset forces FSM state S0 and start_shifting=0 on the settled edge
reset==0 and (state==FOUND or (state==S110 and data==1)); after the settled posedge start_shifting=1 and remains 1 in FOUND until reset
rules.spec_quote: set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset

rules.condition: reset==0 and not (state==FOUND or (state==S110 and data==1)); after the settled posedge start_shifting=0
rules.spec_quote: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: The first sampled posedge row with reset==0 after one or more reset==1 sampled rows is the first released cycle; the FSM starts from S0 and that row's data may begin a new search.

mid: Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.
